name: .172 Cal-21gr Hammer Hunter®
note: Recommended use: Varmint and small game hunting. The product page also says: "This varmint/small game bullet is listed at 9.5″ minimum twist due to the slower velocity 17’s. It will easily stabilize in cartridges similar to the 17 Rem with 10″ twist that will be running velocities well over 4000fps." The product name says 21 gr; the specification says 20 gr.
